title: Buy one electric vehicle, get a free solar generator.
text: Our Black Friday offer runs for a limited time only. You can also fast-charge your EV for ₦350 per kW at our solar-powered charging station at the Silverbird Entertainment Centre, Central Business District, Abuja.

image.alt: 5Points Black Friday promo: buy one electric vehicle and get a free solar generator. Fast charge your EV at ₦350 per kW at Silverbird Entertainment Centre, Abuja. Promo ends Friday 27 November 2026.
